Introduction

Yewon is a South Korean singer and composer under ATTRAKT. Best known for being a member of the girl group FIFTY FIFTY, she was introduced as a member on August 12, 2024, and debuted with the pre-release single "Starry Night" on August 30, 2024.

Prior to her debut, she competed in the survival show "R U Next?" in June 2023, where she was eliminated in episode 6, placing 18th.
